name: leadership-transition
description: Navigate a new leadership role using Michael Watkins' First 90 Days 30/60/90 framework. Use when someone says "I just started a new role", "I'm starting as a new manager", "I joined a new company as a leader", "I was just promoted", "how do I onboard as a leader", "what should I do in my first 30 days", "I inherited a team", "I need a 90 day plan", or "I'm new to this team". Also trigger when someone describes feeling overwhelmed in a new leadership role, unsure where to start, or tempted to make changes too quickly before they've listened. Applies to first-time managers, leaders joining new companies, and leaders moving into new functions or teams within the same company.
